title: Bilaspur Bus Stand Slab Collapse & Gas Rupture
description: Mass casualty commercial building collapse with trapped victims and secondary LPG hazard in crowded transit hub.

incidents.raw_input: पुराने बस स्टैंड के पास इमारत गिर गई है, मलबे में 4 लोग दबे हैं, तुरंत मदद भेजो!

location.address: Old Bus Stand, Raipur Road, Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh

incidents.mission_context: Initial distress call received via ERSS-112 audio channel.

incidents.raw_input: Old Bus stand market complex wall collapsed on road. 4 people trapped inside debris. Strong smell of LPG cylinder gas leak nearby!

location.address: Old Bus Stand Market Complex, Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh

incidents.mission_context: Bystander duplicate report with secondary hazard notice.

incidents.raw_input: Traffic completely choked on Raipur Road near Old Bus Stand. Rubble on arterial blocking ambulance access route.

location.address: Raipur Road Flyover Approach, Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh

title: Yamuna Riverbank Urban Flash Flood
description: Monsoon surge exceeding danger mark, low-lying residential inundation with submerged electrical transformers.

incidents.raw_input: SCADA TELEMETRY: Yamuna river level crossed 208.4 meters at Old Railway Bridge. Water ingress in Monastery Market lowlands.

location.address: Old Railway Bridge, Yamuna Ghat, New Delhi

incidents.raw_input: Ghar mein paani chhat tak pahunch gaya hai, gali ka transformer paani mein doob raha hai current ka khatra hai! NDRF ki boat bhejiye!

location.address: Monastery Market, Kashmiri Gate, New Delhi

incidents.mission_context: Citizen emergency call: high electrocution threat.

incidents.raw_input: Ring Road near ISBT Kashmiri Gate submerged under 3 feet of water. Heavy traffic diversions required immediately.

location.address: ISBT Kashmiri Gate Ring Road, New Delhi

incidents.mission_context: Delhi Traffic Police arterial bypass request.

title: Surat GIDC Ammonia Hazmat Chemical Leak
description: Industrial ammonia tanker valve rupture releasing toxic vapor cloud into worker residential sectors.

incidents.raw_input: CRITICAL HAZMAT: Ammonia gas tank valve rupture at Sachin GIDC Road No. 4. Dense toxic white cloud moving east towards residential colony!

location.address: Sachin GIDC Industrial Area, Surat, Gujarat

incidents.raw_input: Bahar sabhi log behosh ho rahe hain, aankhon mein jalan aur saans lene mein taklif ho rahi hai, ambulances bhejo jaldi!

location.address: GIDC Colony Sector 2, Sachin, Surat, Gujarat
